text:
maria: Quick sync — customer asks for a 90-day onboarding boost: higher quota for first 3 months + one-off credits. Need tradeoffs and launch criteria. Thoughts?

alex: Credits are simplest legally and for billing. Give $$ credits, they consume hosted usage, no quota changes. Easier to revoke if abuse. :thumbsup:

simon: From infra side, quotas are easier to enforce at runtime (soft/hard limits). Credits need billing integration and monitoring. Quota shaping requires burst policy + fallback route. More infra work but better for unit-cost visibility.

jess: From GTM: enterprises hate opaque credits on invoices. They want a line-item and predictable monthly spikes. If we do credits, make them opt-in in contract text.

luis: UX note — show onboarding balance prominently in Console, with expiration warnings at 30/7/1 days. Also surface expected post-onboard rate so customers don't get surprised.

maria: Proposed options: 1) One-off onboarding credits (billing-only) 2) Temporary quota uplift (soft cap up for 90d, then auto-reverts) 3) Hybrid: nominal credits + small temporary uplift. Which should be default?

alex: Default -> credits. Easiest legal + fast rollout. But make quota uplift available for strategic enterprise deals.

simon: Agree default credits, but add a minimal infra hook now: support a simple quota_profile so we can flip on uplift without a deploy. Example: ```
quota_profile:
  tier: pro
  soft_limit: 200000
  onboarding_bonus: 50000
  window_days: 90
```

jess: Add launch guardrails: sales playbook, contract language template, and a cap per-customer. Also require finance signoff for > $X credits.

luis: UI tasks: banner + billing line item + expiration email template. I can sketch mocks next week.

maria: Launch criteria (suggested):
- Telemetry: measure % usage increase in first 30/90 days + retention uplift
- Cost guardrail: incremental unit cost < 20% of predicted revenue uplift
- Controls: ability to revoke credits/uplift from Console + audit log
- Docs & contract templates ready + sales enablement

pricing-bot: Spreadsheet: https://rwd.internal/sheets/onboard-credit-model (updated with cost scenarios)

maria: Next steps: alex to draft billing wording, simon to sketch quota_profile API + rollback plan, luis to start mocks, jess to update playbook. Check back EOD Friday?

alex: On it.

simon: I'll prototype quota_profile toggle and a fallback policy for throttles.

jess: I'll convo with legal about invoice line-item language.

luis: Will drop first mock by Wed.

maria: Thanks everyone — tagging @pricing-bot for scenario calc. :zap:
